entities.summary: Mariam Metwally is an Egyptian female volleyball player, a member of the Egypt women's national volleyball team. She started playing volleyball in Al Ahly Women's Volleyball since she was 7 years old. Mariam joined the Egyptian national team at the age of 16 in 2015 FIVB Volleyball Girls' U18 World Championship in Peru
